benchmark_description: Quantitative comparison of the appearance baseline vs the Eulerian motion-amplified two-stream fusion pipeline on challenging camouflaged video sequences.

metrics.name: Intersection over Union
metrics.description: Area of overlap between predicted camouflage mask and ground truth mask divided by area of union.

metrics.name: Dice Coefficient
metrics.description: Harmonic mean of boundary precision and recall quantifying mask contour accuracy.

metrics.name: Mean Absolute Error
metrics.description: Average pixel-wise error across video frames (lower is better; reflects false-positive clutter).

metrics.name: Structure-measure
metrics.description: Standard camouflage evaluation metric measuring region-aware and object-aware structural similarity.

metrics.name: Weighted F-measure
metrics.description: Precision-recall balance adjusted with spatial distance weighting to penalize boundary bleed.

summary.key_takeaway: Incorporating Eulerian motion-amplified optical flow reduces segmentation error (MAE) by 43.8% and boosts IoU by 26.8% over single-stream appearance models on animals evading visual contrast.
